Monthly average five-year constant-maturity Treasury yield. Synthetic rolling five-year par bond: monthly coupons, flat yield curve, one coupon plus repriced 59 remaining monthly payments. No credit/spread exposure or bond-fund fees; not a broad aggregate index. Uses preceding month yield for coupon, current month yield for repricing. Retrieval uses a revision-pinned public mirror of the source payload; no raw payload is redistributed in this repository.
